ucs.title: [LLM] Akira (Howling Scorpius) — VSS shadow-copy wipe via PowerShell/WMI before encryption
ucs.description: Hunts Akira's signature pre-encryption inhibitor: instead of the noisy `vssadmin delete shadows`, Akira's intrusion playbook (CISA AA24-109A, Sophos, Mandiant) consistently calls `Get-WmiObject Win32_Shadowcopy | Remove-WmiObject` from PowerShell — or the `wmic shadowcopy delete` equivalent — moments before deploying the akira.exe / w.exe / Megazord (Rust) binary. Catching this WMI-mediated VSS wipe gives a ~minutes-wide alert before the .akira / .powerranges extension storm.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="powershell.exe" OR Processes.process_name="pwsh.exe" OR Processes.process_name="wmic.exe") AND (Processes.process="*Win32_Shadowcopy*" OR Processes.process="*shadowcopy delete*" OR (Processes.process="*Shadowcopy*" AND (Processes.process="*Remove-WmiObject*" OR Processes.process="*Remove-CimInstance*"))) by host Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where NOT match(user, "\$$") | rename firstTime as first_seen lastTime as last_seen | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort - last_seen
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wmic.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Win32_Shadowcopy","shadowcopy delete")
    or (ProcessCommandLine has "Shadowcopy"
        and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Remove-WmiObject","Remove-CimInstance","delete"))
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName endswith "\\powershell.exe"
     or NewProcessName endswith "\\pwsh.exe"
     or NewProcessName endswith "\\wmic.exe"
| where CommandLine has_any ("Win32_Shadowcopy","shadowcopy delete")
     or (CommandLine has "Shadowcopy"
         and CommandLine has_any ("Remove-WmiObject","Remove-CimInstance","delete"))
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account = SubjectUserName,
          Parent = ParentProcessName, Child = NewProcessName,
          CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Akira Ransomware VSS Shadow Copy Wipe via WMI/PowerShell
id: 9d3a8b1c-44e2-4b6e-bd0c-0f1a6cf4f1cd
status: experimental
description: Detects the Akira / Howling Scorpius pre-encryption shadow-copy removal pattern using Get-WmiObject Win32_Shadowcopy | Remove-WmiObject or wmic shadowcopy delete (instead of the more common vssadmin).
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-109a
author: SOC Detection Eng
date: 2026-05-29
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\wmic.exe'
  selection_cmd_wmic:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'shadowcopy'
      - 'delete'
  selection_cmd_ps_wmi:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'Win32_Shadowcopy'
  selection_cmd_ps_remove:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'Shadowcopy'
    CommandLine|contains|any:
      - 'Remove-WmiObject'
      - 'Remove-CimInstance'
  filter_machine_acct:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_img and (selection_cmd_wmic or selection_cmd_ps_wmi or selection_cmd_ps_remove) and not filter_machine_acct
fields:
  - Image
  - CommandLine
  - ParentImage
  - User
falsepositives:
  - Backup or storage administration scripts that intentionally prune shadow copies
level: high
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1047
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\PWSH.EXE OR *\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.exe) AND (@CommandLine:*Win32_Shadowcopy* OR @CommandLine:*"shadowcopy delete"* OR (@CommandLine:*Shadowcopy* AND (@CommandLine:*Remove-WmiObject* OR @CommandLine:*Remove-CimInstance*))) AND -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/(powershell|pwsh|wmic)\.exe$/i
| regex("(Win32_Shadowcopy|shadowcopy\\s+delete|Shadowcopy.{0,40}(Remove-WmiObject|Remove-CimInstance))", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count(), limit=200)
| sort(_count, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Most ransomware crews (LockBit, BlackCat, Royal) delete VSS via vssadmin.exe or bcdedit; Akira intrusions repeatedly show the WMI-via-PowerShell variant (Get-WmiObject Win32_Shadowcopy | Remove-WmiObject) plus `wmic shadowcopy delete`, per CISA AA24-109A, Sophos X-Ops, Arctic Wolf, and Unit42 (Howling Scorpius) reporting. Filtering on those two specific invocation shapes — rather than the generic

ucs.title: [LLM] Akira (PUNK SPIDER / GOLD SAHARA) — Rclone/WinSCP exfil to Mega.nz from a host that ran AdFind or SoftPerfect netscan
ucs.description: Chains Akira's two most consistent post-compromise behaviours: AD reconnaissance with AdFind.exe / nltest /domain_trusts / SoftPerfect netscan.exe / Advanced IP Scanner, followed within 24h on the same host by staged exfiltration to Mega.nz using rclone.exe (or WinSCP/FileZilla) — the canonical PUNK SPIDER double-extortion data-theft stack observed by CISA AA24-109A, Sophos, Mandiant, and Palo Alto Unit42. The combo is what separates Akira's hands-on-keyboard intrusion from one-off rclone or one-off AdFind sightings.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as recon_time max(_time) as recon_last from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("adfind.exe","netscan.exe","advanced_ip_scanner.exe","advanced_port_scanner.exe") OR (Processes.process_name="nltest.exe" AND Processes.process="*domain_trusts*") OR (Processes.process_name="net.exe" AND Processes.process="*group \"domain admins\"*")) by host Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename dest as recon_host | join type=inner recon_host [ | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as exfil_time max(_time) as exfil_last from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="rclone.exe" OR Processes.process_name="winscp.exe" OR Processes.process_name="winscp.com" OR Processes.process="*mega.nz*" OR Processes.process="*mega.co.nz*" OR Processes.process="*mega.io*" OR (Processes.process_name="rclone.exe" AND (Processes.process="*copy*" OR Processes.process="*sync*" OR Processes.process="*--config*"))) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename dest as recon_host process as exfil_process process_name as exfil_proc_name ] | eval delta=exfil_time-recon_time | where delta>=0 AND delta<=86400 | convert ctime(recon_time) ctime(exfil_time) | table recon_host user recon_time process_name process exfil_time exfil_proc_name exfil_process delta | sort - exfil_time
ucs.kql:
let Recon = DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName in~ ("adfind.exe","netscan.exe","advanced_ip_scanner.exe","advanced_port_scanner.exe")
    or (FileName =~ "nltest.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "domain_trusts")
    or (FileName =~ "net.exe"   and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("group","domain admins"))
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project ReconTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ReconImage=FileName, ReconCmd=ProcessCommandLine;
let Exfil = DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName in~ ("rclone.exe","winscp.exe","winscp.com","filezilla.exe")
     or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("mega.nz","mega.co.nz","mega.io","mega:")
     or (FileName in~ ("rclone.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("copy","sync","move","--config","--no-check-certificate"))
| project ExfilTime=Timestamp, DeviceId,
          ExfilImage=FileName, ExfilCmd=ProcessCommandLine;
Recon
| join kind=inner Exfil on DeviceId
| where ExfilTime between (ReconTime .. ReconTime + 24h)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ExfilTime, ReconTime)
| project ReconTime, ExfilTime, DelaySec, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ReconImage, ReconCmd, ExfilImage, ExfilCmd
| order by ExfilTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Recon = SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName endswith "\\adfind.exe"
     or NewProcessName endswith "\\netscan.exe"
     or NewProcessName endswith "\\advanced_ip_scanner.exe"
     or NewProcessName endswith "\\advanced_port_scanner.exe"
     or (NewProcessName endswith "\\nltest.exe" and CommandLine has "domain_trusts")
     or (NewProcessName endswith "\\net.exe"   and CommandLine has_all ("group","domain admins"))
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project ReconTime=TimeGenerated, Computer, Account=SubjectUserName,
          ReconImage=NewProcessName, ReconCmd=CommandLine;
let Exfil = SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName endswith "\\rclone.exe"
     or NewProcessName endswith "\\winscp.exe"
     or NewProcessName endswith "\\winscp.com"
     or NewProcessName endswith "\\filezilla.exe"
     or CommandLine has_any ("mega.nz","mega.co.nz","mega.io","mega:")
| project ExfilTime=TimeGenerated, Computer,
          ExfilImage=NewProcessName, ExfilCmd=CommandLine;
Recon
| join kind=inner Exfil on Computer
| where ExfilTime between (ReconTime .. ReconTime + 24h)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ExfilTime, ReconTime)
| project ReconTime, ExfilTime, DelaySec, Computer, Account,
          ReconImage, ReconCmd, ExfilImage, ExfilCmd
| order by ExfilTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@Image:(*\\rclone.exe OR *\\Rclone.exe OR *\\RCLONE.EXE OR *\\winscp.exe OR *\\WinSCP.exe OR *\\winscp.com OR *\\filezilla.exe OR *\\FileZilla.exe) OR @CommandLine:(*mega.nz* OR *mega.co.nz* OR *mega.io* OR *"mega:"*)) AND @CommandLine:(*copy* OR *sync* OR *move* OR *--config* OR *sftp:* OR *ftp:*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/(rclone|winscp(\.com)?|filezilla)\.exe$/i OR regex("mega(\\.nz|\\.co\\.nz|\\.io|:)", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| regex("(copy|sync|move|--config|sftp:|ftp:)", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| join({
    #event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
    | ImageFileName=/(adfind|netscan|advanced_(ip|port)_scanner)\.exe$/i OR (ImageFileName=/nltest\.exe$/i AND regex("domain_trusts", field=CommandLine, flags="i")) OR (ImageFileName=/net\.exe$/i AND regex("group.{0,5}(\"|')?domain admins", field=CommandLine, flags="i"))
    | NOT UserName=/\$$/
    | rename(field="_time", as="recon_time")
    | rename(field="CommandLine", as="ReconCmd")
    | rename(field="ImageFileName", as="ReconImage")
  }, field=aid, include=[recon_time, ReconCmd, ReconImage])
| test(_time - recon_time <= 86400 AND _time - recon_time >= 0)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ReconImage, ReconCmd, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count(), limit=200)
| sort(_count, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: AdFind + Mega.nz/Rclone is the well-documented PUNK SPIDER / GOLD SAHARA double-extortion stack — see CISA AA24-109A, Sophos X-Ops, Arctic Wolf, Mandiant, and Unit42 Howling Scorpius write-ups. Either side alone is a hunt; the same-host, ≤24h chain is what catches the actual Akira operator's playbook between TA0007 (Discovery) and TA0010 (Exfiltration), and gives the SOC a window to interdict befo
